5º de Primaria · Inglés · Tema 8

Holidays and travel

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________

Qué vas a aprender

  • Learn vocabulary about holidays, transport and places to stay
  • Talk about past holidays with the past simple
  • Pack a suitcase and talk about the weather
  • Use useful phrases at the airport, the station and the hotel

Para pensar

Cuando vuelves de vacaciones, tus amigos te preguntan «How was your holiday?». ¿Qué les contarías?

Explicación

Types of holiday

There are many kinds of holiday. A beach holiday: swimming, sunbathing, building sandcastles. A mountain holiday: hiking, climbing, skiing in winter. A city break: visiting museums, monuments and markets. A camping trip: sleeping in a tent and cooking outdoors. A visit to family in the village.

En castellano: holiday son las vacaciones (en inglés americano, vacation). Trip es un viaje corto o una excursión, y journey, el trayecto de un sitio a otro.

Transport: how did you travel?

We say how we travel with by + transport: by car, by plane, by train, by bus (or by coach for long trips), by boat or by ferry, by bike. But we say on foot (a pie)!

«How did you travel?» «We travelled by train. It was faster than the car.» «We went to Mallorca by ferry.» Verbs: we get on a train or a plane (subir) and get off (bajar). We take a taxi and catch a bus. Ojo: no decimos «by the car».

Where did you stay?

Places to stay: a hotel, an apartment, a campsite (camping) in a tent or a caravan, a youth hostel (albergue), a cottage in the countryside, or your relatives' house.

«We stayed at a hotel near the beach.» «We stayed in a tent for a week.» «We stayed with my grandparents.» At a hotel we book a room (reservar), check in when we arrive and check out when we leave. A single room is for one person and a double room for two.

Packing your suitcase

Before a trip we pack our suitcase (maleta) or backpack (mochila). What do you need? Clothes: T-shirts, shorts, a jumper, a raincoat, a swimsuit, trainers, a cap. Other things: a toothbrush, sun cream, sunglasses, a towel, a camera, a map, a charger.

For international trips you need a passport or an ID card and a ticket. «Don't forget your passport!» «Have you got the tickets?» «I need to pack my sun cream.» Consejo: haz una lista para no olvidar nada.

The weather on holiday

The weather changes our holiday plans. Remember the adjectives: sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy, snowy, foggy, stormy; and temperatures: hot, warm, cool, cold, freezing.

To talk about past holidays we use was: «It was sunny and hot every day.» «On Tuesday it was stormy, so we stayed in the hotel.» To ask: «What was the weather like?» (¿Qué tiempo hizo?) «It was windy but warm.»

Holiday activities

What can you do on holiday? go sightseeing (hacer turismo), visit a museum, take photos, buy souvenirs (recuerdos), go swimming, go hiking, go fishing, ride a horse, try local food, send postcards, meet new friends.

In the past simple: «We went sightseeing in Rome.» «I took lots of photos.» «My sister bought a souvenir.» «We tried paella in Valencia.» «I met a girl from Ireland.» Many of these verbs are irregular: go → went, take → took, buy → bought, meet → met.

At the airport and the station

Useful phrases when you travel. At the airport: «Can I see your passport and boarding pass, please?» «Here you are.» «Your flight leaves from gate 12.» «Is this your luggage?»

At the train station: «A return ticket to York, please.» (ida y vuelta) «A single, please.» (solo ida) «What time does the train leave?» «At 10:15, from platform 3.» «How much is it?» «It's 12 pounds.» Consejo: usa siempre please, thank you y excuse me.

Reading: a postcard from Scotland

Read Lola's postcard: «Dear Abril, greetings from Scotland! We arrived in Edinburgh last Saturday by plane. We're staying at a small hotel near the castle. On Sunday we went sightseeing and I took hundreds of photos. On Monday we travelled by train to the Highlands. The mountains were beautiful but it was rainy and windy, so I bought a warm jumper! Yesterday we saw a lake where people look for a monster. We didn't see it! See you soon. Love, Lola.»

How did Lola travel? Where is she staying? What was the weather like in the Highlands?

Let's practise: my dream holiday

Interview a classmate about their last holiday: «Where did you go? How did you travel? Where did you stay? What was the weather like? What did you do? Did you buy any souvenirs?» Write the answers and tell the class.

Then write a postcard from a real or imaginary holiday (60-80 words). Start with Dear… and finish with Love, or See you soon, and your name. Repaso: by + transporte (pero on foot), stay at/in/with, y verbos en pasado: went, took, bought, saw.

Holidays and travel

Ejercicios

  1. Translate: maleta, billete, pasaporte, recuerdo.

  2. Complete: «We travelled ___ plane.»

  3. Complete: «We stayed ___ a hotel.»

  4. Write in English: «billete de ida y vuelta».

  5. Past simple: «I take photos and I meet new friends.»

  6. What do you pack for a beach holiday? Name four things.

  7. Make the question: «___ did you stay?» — «In a tent.»

  8. Correct: «We went to Paris by the train.»

  9. Answer: «How was your holiday?» (genial)

  10. Write three sentences about your last holiday.

Practica

  1. «Suitcase» is…

    1. A) mochila
    2. B) billete
    3. C) maleta

  2. «We went to Ibiza ___ boat.»

    1. A) by
    2. B) on
    3. C) in

  3. «A pie» is…

    1. A) by foot
    2. B) on foot
    3. C) with feet

  4. «Campsite» is…

    1. A) hotel
    2. B) camping
    3. C) albergue

  5. The past of «buy» is…

    1. A) buyed
    2. B) brought
    3. C) bought

  6. «What was the weather like?» — «It ___ sunny.»

    1. A) was
    2. B) is
    3. C) did

  7. «Souvenir» is…

    1. A) postal
    2. B) maleta
    3. C) recuerdo

  8. «A return ticket» is…

    1. A) solo ida
    2. B) ida y vuelta
    3. C) billete de avión

  9. «go sightseeing» means…

    1. A) hacer turismo
    2. B) ir de compras
    3. C) ir a la playa

  10. «We stayed ___ my grandparents.»

    1. A) with
    2. B) at
    3. C) by

Explícalo con tus palabras

Incluye: Qué tipos de vacaciones y alojamientos hay; Cómo se dice el medio de transporte en inglés; Qué preguntas y frases sirven en un aeropuerto o una estación; Cómo se cuenta un viaje en pasado.

Resumen

Tarjetas de repaso

Recórtalas: pregunta delante, respuesta detrás.

holidayVacaciones.
tripViaje corto, excursión.
by plane / by trainEn avión / en tren.
on footA pie.
suitcaseMaleta.
campsiteCamping.
souvenirRecuerdo.
What was the weather like?¿Qué tiempo hizo?

Soluciones

  1. C) Suitcase = maleta.
  2. A) by + transporte.
  3. B) On foot.
  4. B) Lugar para acampar.
  5. C) Irregular.
  6. A) Pasado: was.
  7. C) Lo que compras para recordar.
  8. B) Return = vuelta.
  9. A) Ver los lugares.
  10. A) Stay with + personas.

Soluciones de los ejercicios

  1. suitcase, ticket, passport, souvenir.
  2. by.
  3. at.
  4. a return ticket.
  5. I took photos and I met new friends.
  6. Model answer: a swimsuit, sun cream, a towel and sunglasses.
  7. Where.
  8. We went to Paris by train.
  9. It was great! / It was fantastic!
  10. Model answer: I went to the village. We travelled by car. It was sunny and I swam in the river.
